description: This PHP source file generates a web interface for managing cordless handsets, including listing connected handsets, registering/deregistering handsets, and configuring related settings such as CAT-iq enabling and PIN management.

methods.name: init_data
methods.description: Initializes the page data by rendering the list of handsets and setting up UI elements based on current configuration.

methods.name: ajax_do
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to apply configuration changes asynchronously.
